shared_elements: animal head in strict profile facing left
curled/spiral horn or curl motif at side of head
large almond eye with defined lid in profile
rows of repeated small curls or scale-like units used as infill texture
relief figures oriented in a leftward procession/movement
partial human figure/limb behind or beside the animal
justification: Both show a large-headed creature in strict left-facing profile with a prominent curled horn-like spiral beside the eye, a big almond eye, and dense rows of small repeated curls/scales used as decorative infill on the body, in low relief with the body filling the field. The biggest difference in content is the subject itself: A is a pair of naturalistic horned rams walking, driven by a human whose legs and hands appear above, while B is a single winged raptor-headed anthropomorphic being with a hooked beak and multiple layered wings, with no herd or procession of real animals.
